670:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not that this is any time to be saying that again, but for now we're open for business!」

670:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for our ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion, but I'll give it my all again today... business, business!」

671:t_000:1.en:
$$アマタ$$
「It's $$ミカゲ$$! He got aboard the $$クォーター$$ and went after $$ランカ$$!」

671:t_001:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$! Answer me, $$ランカ$$!」

671:t_001:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Sad, isn't it, girl with the spring-green hair? Does it not feel like your heart will burst? To be torn away from the one you love...」

671:t_001:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That sorrow, that pain, that suffering, I have tasted for tens of thousands... hundreds of millions of times longer than you.」

671:t_001:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「And you know... the girl with the pale pink and gold hair will be tormented by sorrow, pain and suffering greater than yours from now on, for eternity.」

671:t_001:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That is the fault of you and him... The one dear to you chooses you, and in doing so makes another person dear to him suffer.」

671:t_001:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes... your very existence is the root of all sin.」

671:t_001:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... she will probably never be able to sing again.」

671:t_001:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! You bastard, what are you saying to $$ランカ$$!?」

671:t_001:12.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It is too late. She has fallen.」

671:t_001:16.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have waited for this moment all along. It was not the direction I had foreseen, but the fruit of despair has ripened.」

671:t_001:17.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Her despair, my love and my hatred... When these three come together, a new power is born.」

671:t_001:18.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes... that is the Wings of Darkness!」

671:t_002:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ランカ$$! Answer me, $$ランカ$$!」

671:t_002:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Sad, isn't it, girl with the spring-green hair? Does it not feel like your heart will burst? To be torn away from the one you love...」

671:t_002:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「That sorrow, that pain, that suffering, I have tasted for tens of thousands... hundreds of millions of times longer than you.」

671:t_002:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But you know... girl with the spring-green hair. Even if he comes to save you, you will never be allowed to leap into his arms.」

671:t_002:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「No matter how loudly you cry out... no matter how you sing, your feelings will never reach his heart.」

671:t_002:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It is not you he will hold.」

671:t_002:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh... slipping into his heart while the girl with the pale pink and gold hair was away was all for nothing, too.」

671:t_002:11.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It's all right, girl with the spring-green hair. I will save you from your unrequited feelings.」

671:t_002:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! You bastard, what are you saying to $$ランカ$$!?」

671:t_002:13.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「It is too late. She has fallen.」

671:t_002:17.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have waited for this moment all along. For despair to grow, quietly and slowly, over time, and to bear fruit.」

671:t_002:18.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Her despair, my love and my hatred... When these three come together, a new power is born.」

671:t_002:19.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes... that is the Wings of Darkness!」

671:t_003:2.en:
$$カグラ$$
「What the hell is going on! The $$神話型アクエリオン$$ is right here with us!」

671:t_003:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Love and hatred are two sides of the same coin...」

671:t_003:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「If the filthy proof of love between $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ and a Wingless is the Wings of the Sun, then my eternal hatred of the Wingless is these Wings of Darkness...」

671:t_003:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Yes! This black Mechanical Angel is the flip side of my love for $$アポロニアス#pilot$$!」

671:t_003:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! If you hate us, I'll take you on!」

671:t_003:7.en:
$$アポロ$$
「And don't drag $$ランカ$$ into this, she has nothing to do with it!」

671:t_003:8.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Nothing to do with it...? Is that truly so?」

671:t_003:11.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「This girl tried to obtain love. That is a sin worthy of ten thousand deaths...!」

671:t_003:12.en:
$$カレン$$
「Enough with the jealousy and taking it out on people!」

671:t_003:13.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Are you planning to turn everyone who loves each other into tools for your revenge!?」

671:t_003:15.en:
$$桂$$
「Quit joking. That's the same as saying you'll kill everyone in the world.」

671:t_003:16.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You may take it that way.」

671:t_003:18.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Soon, with the mass outbreak of $$バアル$$, the great collapse that destroys all universes will begin.」

671:t_003:19.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I will watch it happen, and cast my thoughts back to the days of love with $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, now so far away.」

671:t_003:20.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's no use...! There's no talking to him!」

671:t_003:21.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I never had a tongue to speak with the Wingless to begin with. All you will do is meet a wretched death here.」
